scheme_name: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a student who has secured admission in an approved Masters, M.Phil or PhD programme abroad.
The applicant must have availed a loan from a scheduled bank under the Education Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA).
At least 50% of the annual outlay is earmarked for interest subsidy to female candidates.
The interest subsidy claim is limited to a maximum loan component of ₹20,00,000 per student.
benefits_summary: The Government subsidises interest on education loans up to ₹20,00,000 for eligible OBC/EBC students during the moratorium period of their overseas Masters, M.Phil or PhD studies.
